name: Quality Plastics Inc.
old_description: Quality Plastics & Machine, Incorporated has made custom plastic products for a variety of industries since its inception in 1976. Our products have filled many functions in laboratories, medical equipment, displays, electronics, motor vehicles, entertainment, agriculture, watercraft, aircraft, and even outer space.
about:
Quality Plastics & Machine, Incorporated was founded in 1976 in Sparks, Nevada. The company began as a custom plastics fabricator and has since expanded into machining, forming, and assembly services. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The shop’s core process is vacuum forming of thermoplastic sheets, supplemented by drape forming for optically clear curved parts. It operates CNC machining centers including a dual-spindle lathe with live tooling, 5-axis and 3-axis routers, laser cutting systems, and 3D printers for prototypes and fixtures. Fabrication services cover trimming, riveting, threaded inserts, and hardware installation, while the assembly department handles everything from simple hardware to full electro‑mechanical builds. The company also designs and builds custom automated machinery to accelerate production runs. Volumes range from prototype to production quantities; no facility size or headcount figures are published.

Customers span laboratories, medical equipment, displays, electronics, motor vehicles, entertainment, agriculture, watercraft, aircraft, and aerospace — including components flown on multiple space‑shuttle missions. The firm serves both OEMs and design engineers seeking turnkey production from concept to shelf‑ready product.

Quality Plastics emphasizes its ability to assist with product design, create tooling in‑house, and deliver on schedule. It positions itself as a problem‑solver, stating that if a requirement falls outside its capabilities it will help the customer find an alternative source.
